description.value: Bomber Brewing is an East Vancouver craft brewery and taproom situated on Adanac Street, one of the city's most-used cycling routes. The taproom pours a rotating lineup of Czech-style lagers, IPAs, sours, and stouts alongside a food truck (B'SHAKE BURGER), making it a natural rest stop for cyclists passing through East Van. Package sales and delivery via Uber Eats and DoorDash are also available.
